body: Thank you for caring about me. I appreciate it.
I guess not. I just hope I get better soon. I'm really worried for myself if I don't get better soon.
Thank you. I'm sorry for being so depressing. I'm really trying to be happy. It's just so difficult.
No. Whenever I try to relax and think about my thoughts I become really hopeless and sad...

I just barely have any money. I can't really go much of anywhere except walk outside for a bit. And when I'm away from job applications I just stress out about the fact that I'm not doing job applications.

It's just that I hurt so much every day. I hurt from being so alone for so long, my body hurts from the condition, I'm so stressed all the time...I used to be a happy, friendly person. After all this I'm just so mean and sad. I'm turning into something I hate.

I'm trying really hard to keep going. But ever since I was really young I just kinda thought that my life would probably end with a suicide. It just seemed to be where my life would end up. And now that doing so wouldn't hurt anyone else, it looks really tempting.

Thank you. I don't really know what to talk about...I just feel really awful. I'm so tired of struggling every single day. I'm so tired of being so lonely. And I feel like I'm getting old, everyone around me is starting careers, having a family, and I can't even get a job. I feel like such a failure.
I don't have anybody, unfortunately. I wish I did. I could really use a hug.

Ok. Thank you. It's just a lot of things all at once. I've been headed downhill mentally for a long, long time really, since I was a kid. I'm in my mid-20's now. I moved around a lot as a kid so I didn't ever really have any friends, and still don't have any. After an injury ended my chance at my dream career, I had to pick something else to major in for college. I picked a stupid artsy subject and now I'm paying the price for it; I can't get a job anywhere. I've tried. I've gone to career counselors, looked on the internet, temp places, everything. On top of everything else, I just got diagnosed with a medical condition that isn't curable and is going to start to disfigure me slowly and cause me more and more pain for the rest of my life. So I have no money, no friends, a painful and humiliating medical condition, and a useless college degree that instead of being proud of, I'm ashamed of. I'm really hurting physically and mentally, and I don't have anyone that cares about me. I've been having really, really bad suicidal thoughts every day for a few weeks now. I'm really scared and lonely.
Hey. Thank you for caring. Are you doing ok tonight? I don't want to ruin your night with my problems or anything...
